name: frameforge
description: Make deterministic motion-graphics and explainer videos with a local Frameforge engine.
long_description: Drives a local Frameforge checkout: create films, write their code, generate music, render MP4s, contact sheets and stills (returned as images), run the quality checks and open the studio on 127.0.0.1. Needs a clone of the engine with npm ci, Chrome, ffmpeg and Python with numpy. Nothing leaves your machine.

engine_dir.title: Frameforge engine folder
engine_dir.description: A clone of github.com/jonsoku-dev/frameforge where npm ci has run

project_dir.title: Project folder
project_dir.description: A Frameforge project (frameforge init). Empty: the engine's examples/samples

chrome_path.title: Chrome executable
chrome_path.description: Only when Chrome is not in the usual place
